title: Mixed Event — Here on Our Dream Stage — Episode9 All of Us Together

meta.Event Outline: The schools of Shibuya are holding the Shibuya City High Schools Joint Festival, a place for students to put on performances. Nene takes on the task of putting on a musical with students from other schools.

rows.Line: The day of Shibu Schools Fest

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This audience is bigger than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. This is an official Shibuya event, after all.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This feels so different from one of our usual shows...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know what you mean!
The crowd always cheers and stuff during the events we perform in, but things are so quiet here.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: I'm starting to get a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: What do I do if I forget my lines...?

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: I'm scared. What if we miss our cue to start playing? We might end up confusing the cast...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Which makes sense...
I mean, a lot of them are doing this for the first time.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (What's the right thing to tell them in this situation?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Have confidence in the all the hard work you've put in until now. As long as you play the way you practiced, this show's gonna be absolutely awesome!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Your efforts are going to pay off!
Believe in yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, Airi Momoi's absolutely right!
You've all come such a long way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know that for a fact, since I've been with you all since day one! You've all become wonderful actors!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In other words, instead of feeling scared or worried, we should be telling ourselves that we're gonna succeed, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's have confidence in our abilities, and give the audience a show they're going to remember!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's send them all home smiling☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We aren't going up on that stage alone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The cast, the band, the songwriters and everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: All the people who were involved in making this show happen are by your side.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
They're your friends and allies.
So, don't worry.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's go out there and put on the best show ever!

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: Our special presentation of “A Dream On A Melody”, brought to you by the planning committee, will begin momentarily.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...!
It's starting soon... I-I'm getting nervous...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, why are you guys feeling nervous?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When do we get to see the backgrounds you and the others made, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: During the scene where the protagonist sneaks into town. I'm really proud of what we made, so get ready.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You helped design the costumes, right, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup!
I'm also really proud of what we made, so keep your eyes peeled♪

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “I'm tired of sewing, playing with dolls and reading. It's all so dreary.”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “They say the outside world is full of dangers. I haven't the courage to go out, but...”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The protagonist is feeling a mix of both fear and excitement regarding the outside world...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I see. So that's how she's chosen to express the feelings in this song.)

rows.Speaker: Music-loving Girl
rows.Line: “Hehehe♪ I really love the way you sing, so I couldn't help but jump in!”

rows.Speaker: Nameless Musician
rows.Line: “Hehe. I also love the way you sing.”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
“Oh... A-Actually...
This is my first time hearing it.”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
“But I do think I enjoyed it...
Now that I've heard you perform it.”

rows.Speaker: Nameless Musician
rows.Line:
“Then, why don't I teach it to you?
We can sing it together.”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “This is incredible! So many people are singing in the plaza...!”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It looks like a fun little town.

rows.Speaker: Dancing Musician
rows.Line: “Hehehe. Hello there, young lady! Aren't you just the cutest?”

rows.Speaker: Dancing Musician
rows.Line: “I'm a musician who loves to dance and sing! Would you like to hear me sing something?”

rows.Speaker: Street Musician
rows.Line:
“You should also listen to me!
I guarantee you won't be disappointed!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Everyone seems relaxed, their delivery sounds natural...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The band's putting on a wonderful performance, too. They're doing an impeccable job of showing how fun and free this town is, and how the protagonist's feelings are soaring.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Lulu decides that she also wants to become a musician after becoming friends with them. But the butler soon catches her sneaking out of the mansion.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She feels bad for making everyone worry, and decides to return to her boring old life.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This is your time to shine, Nene.)

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
“I'm so bored...
More than ever before...”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “It's as though all the color has faded from the world.”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “After all, I know how wonderful music is now. I know how it can bring joy to others...”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
“That voice...
It came from outside the mansion. Could it be...?”

rows.Speaker: Tutor
rows.Line: “The young lady will no longer be setting foot outside of this mansion. I ask that you please disperse.”

rows.Speaker: Tutor
rows.Line: “Yes, she does not wish to see any of you ever again.”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “That song... It's the first one I heard when...”

rows.Speaker: Nameless Musician
rows.Line:
“Hey, can you hear me?!
Let's sing together again!”

rows.Speaker: Street Musician
rows.Line: “Are you really going to let your dream end like this?”

rows.Speaker: Music-loving Girl
rows.Line: “I want to hear you sing more, Lulu!”

rows.Speaker: Dancing Musician
rows.Line:
“Yes, pursuing your dream isn't easy!
Neither is staying true to your feelings.”

rows.Speaker: Dancing Musician
rows.Line: “But you have all of us on your side!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (She's channeling all of her feelings into the song I wrote!)

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
“Thank you...
For reminding me of the joy I felt when I first heard you all perform. For giving me the courage to move forward.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I promise to take all the feelings you've put into this show, and sing like I never have before!)

rows.Speaker: Tutor
rows.Line:
“What...?!
Was that really you just now? That was so beautiful...”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “I want my songs to make everyone around the world smile...”

rows.Speaker: Dancing Musician
rows.Line: “All of us. Together. Now and forever!”
